result.description:
Salary: $67,510 to $72,000
Location: Darwin / Batchelor, NT

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. With a growing team and service locations across multiple sites, they are seeking a General Clerk to support daily administration, customer enquiries, scheduling assistance, records management, data entry, filing, and general office support.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain business records, including customer details, bookings, invoices, and service documentation.
- Handle incoming communications (emails, calls, messages) and respond to customer enquiries regarding bookings and services.
- Enter and update data in systems and spreadsheets, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
- Assist with preparing routine reports such as schedules, service records, attendance, and stock usage.
- Maintain records of cleaning equipment and supplies issued to staff.
- Support document management, including scanning, filing, and organising office and compliance paperwork.
- Assist with rostering and scheduling cleaning staff across various sites.
- Provide accurate information to customers and site contacts about services and bookings.
- Perform general receptionist duties, including answering calls and directing enquiries.
- Support stock control by tracking usage and assisting with ordering.
- Assist management with general administrative tasks to support daily operations.

Selection Criteria
- Previous clerical, administration, receptionist, customer service, or office support experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
- Good computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, calendars, data entry, and document management.
- Clear and professional communication skills when dealing with customers, staff, suppliers, and site contacts.
- Ability to organise tasks, follow instructions, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities.
- Ability to handle confidential business, client, and staff information appropriately.
- Willingness to work in a busy service-based business supporting cleaning teams across multiple sites.
- Understanding of workplace health and safety administration, stock records, or service scheduling will be highly regarded.

Required Experience and Qualifications
- AQF Certificate II or III in Business, Administration, Clerical Services, or a related field is preferred.
- At least one year of relevant clerical, administrative, receptionist, or office support experience
- Experience in cleaning, facilities, hospitality, accommodation, aged care, or other service-based industries will be highly regarded.
- Full working rights in Australia are required.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, organised, and detail-oriented General Clerk to join us and help support the smooth day-to-day administration of our cleaning services business.

To apply, please submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the General Clerk role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 August 2026

Position: Cabinet Maker
Type: Full-time
Employer: Final Touch Joinery Pty Ltd
Location: Kenthurst NSW 2156
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Final Touch Joinery Pty Ltd is a reputable North-West Sydney-based cabinetry specialist established in 2006 by Director Nathan Diab. With a strong commitment to quality craftsmanship and exceptional customer service, the company specialises in custom kitchen joinery, wardrobes, vanities, and architectural fit-outs for both residential and commercial clients, including high-end homes, unit developments, pubs, clubs, and insurance repair projects. Using premium materials and advanced CAD software, Final Touch Joinery delivers tailored solutions that bring clients’ visions to life with precision, durability, and elegant finishes. The business prides itself on a collaborative, detail-oriented workplace culture where innovation meets traditional joinery skills in a supportive environment focused on excellence and client satisfaction.
About the Position:
The Cabinet Maker plays a vital role in fabricating, assembling, and installing high-quality custom cabinetry, kitchens, wardrobes, and other joinery solutions for Final Touch Joinery’s diverse residential and commercial projects. Working from detailed drawings and client specifications, this position contributes directly to creating functional, beautiful spaces that meet the highest standards of finish and craftsmanship, helping the company maintain its reputation for premium, personalised results in the joinery industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Examining drawings, work orders, and sample parts to determine specifications.
Selecting and working with materials such as timber, veneers, particle board, laminates, and other engineered wood products.
Marking out, cutting, shaping, and assembling components using hand tools, power tools, and computer numerical control (CNC) machines where applicable.
Fabricating and installing kitchen, bathroom, and other cabinetry, wardrobes, counters, and fittings.
Fitting hinges, locks, catches, drawers, shelves, and other hardware with precision.
Ensuring all work meets quality standards, safety requirements, and client expectations.
Collaborating with the team on commercial and residential fit-outs, including repairs and custom solutions.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Minimum Certificate III in Cabinet Making and Installation, Joinery, or any relevant field or at least 2 years of relevant experience.
Minimum 2 years of experience as a cabinet maker or in a related field.
Strong technical skills in reading technical drawings, precise measurement, woodworking machinery operation, and use of hand/power tools.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.
Good interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and understand client requirements.
Physical fitness and ability to work safely in a workshop and on-site environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Bulldozer Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Bulldozer Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of bulldozers to undertake bulk earthworks, clearing, site preparation, material spreading, pushing, ripping and final shaping activities across construction, civil, mining infrastructure and non-process infrastructure (NPI) projects. The role is responsible for achieving production targets while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate bulldozers safely and efficiently to undertake bulk earthworks, site preparation and construction activities. 
-  Clear vegetation, topsoil and unsuitable material from work areas in accordance with project requirements. 
-  Push, spread and level soil, rock, gravel and other construction materials. 
-  Carry out ripping, backfilling and ground preparation activities. 
-  Construct and maintain building pads, hardstands, access roads and haul roads. 
-  Perform final trim works to specified design levels and project tolerances where required. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, GPS machine control systems and supervisor instructions.
-  Conduct daily pre-start inspections and complete required plant inspection documentation. 
-  Monitor equipment performance and report faults or maintenance requirements promptly. 
-  Carry out routine servicing, lubrication and minor maintenance within competency limits. 
-  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox meetings and safety interactions. 
-  Operate safely around personnel, mobile plant, underground services and fixed infrastructure. 
-  Maintain compliance with Grounded, client and statutory safety requirements. 
-  Complete required plant logs, inspection records and production documentation accurately. 
-  Assist with site establishment and other construction activities where required. 
-  Maintain housekeeping standards around work areas and equipment. 
-  Contribute to achieving project production, quality and safety objectives. 


Skills and Abilities:
-  Relevant qualification equivalent to AQF Certificate II or Certificate III, or equivalent industry experience. 
-  Minimum one (1) year relevant experience operating bulldozers.
